questions.cardText:
[Botany] What is the fastest-growing plant?
A. Kudzu
B. Bamboo
C. Sunflower
Answer: B. Certain species of bamboo can grow up to 91 cm (35 in) within a 24-hour period.
questions.de: Welche Pflanze, von der manche Arten bis zu 91 cm innerhalb von 24 Stunden wachsen können, gilt als die am schnellsten wachsende Pflanze?
questions.en: Which plant, certain species of which can grow up to 91 cm (35 in) within 24 hours, holds the record as the fastest-growing plant?

timeline.labelEn: Christian Luerssen names the bamboo subfamily Bambusoideae
timeline.labelDe: Christian Luerssen benennt die Bambus-Unterfamilie Bambusoideae

questions.notes: The 91 cm/24 h figure is the Guinness World Records 'fastest growing plant' entry. By biomass doubling time, duckweeds such as Wolffia grow faster.

questions.cardText:
[Astronomy] How did researchers find out that the universe is expanding?
A. By observing the rotation of galaxies
B. By reviewing cosmic radiation patterns
C. By studying distant galaxies’ light
Answer: C. Researchers discovered that the universe is expanding by observing that the light from distant galaxies shifts to the red end of the spectrum. This shift happens because as galaxies move away from us, the light waves they emit stretch out, making the light appear redder.
questions.de: Welche Verschiebung im Licht ferner Galaxien zeigte den Forschern, dass sich das Universum ausdehnt?
questions.en: What shift in the light of distant galaxies revealed to researchers that the universe is expanding?

timeline.labelEn: Edwin Hubble publishes the relation between galaxies' distance and redshift (Hubble's law)
timeline.labelDe: Edwin Hubble veröffentlicht den Zusammenhang zwischen Entfernung und Rotverschiebung von Galaxien (Hubble-Gesetz)

questions.notes: Georges Lemaître derived the expansion from redshift data already in 1927; Hubble's 1929 paper is usually credited.
